name: Berlin Brandenburg Airport

curfew.v: no take-offs or landings from 23:30 to 05:30 local time (exceptions: emergencies, safety diversions, relief, medical, state flights, weekday mail and some delayed/early scheduled flights); 23:00-24:00 and 05:00-06:00 count against an annual night quota; jets over 20,000 kg from 22:00 to 06:00 must be at least 10 EPNdB below the noise limits
curfew.quote: In der Zeit zwischen 23:30 und 05:30 Uhr Ortszeit dürfen keine Luftfahrzeuge starten oder landen.

slots.v: Level 3 coordinated airport; general aviation flights need a slot from the German airport coordinator (Fluko)
slots.quote: Coordination of General Aviation flights is required at the following Level 3 airports:

runway.v: two parallel runways: the southern runway (06R/24L since 3 Oct 2024) is 4,000 m long and 60 m wide; the northern runway (06L/24R) is 3,600 m long
runway.quote: Die südliche Start- und Landebahn ist 4.000 Meter lang und 60 Meter breit.

handling.v: All general aviation flights must use the General Aviation Terminal, and users choose among the approved handlers. The operator's GAT page says the terminal is operated by BAS Berlin Aviation Service GmbH as its contracted service provider
handling.quote: All general aviation flights must use the General Aviation Terminal (GAT) at the airport.

also.quote: operated by BAS Berlin Aviation Service GmbH as the contracted service provider of Flughafen Berlin Brandenburg GmbH.

customs.v: Customs office at the airport is not H24: Mon-Fri 06:15-22:00 and Sun 14:15-22:00 local, open on public holidays. The page shows no Saturday line. These are the office's general hours; the page does not say how general aviation flights are cleared, and commercial goods follow the Customs Office List
